name: PixelSnow-TS-TW
blurb: Falling pixelated snowflakes (or squares/circles) in a 3D depth-aware field.
description: WebGL shader performing 3D ray-tracing of procedurally-placed flakes with depth sorting, wind direction, and density controls. Pauses rendering when offscreen.
use_when: Seasonal or magical backgrounds, hero sections, or any context needing a continuous, subtle falling-particle effect.
avoid_when: WebGL-unsupported devices, performance-critical mobile, or environments requiring motion to be disabled — the 128-iteration raymarching is expensive.
a11y: Passive visual background; no keyboard interaction or focus states. Does not respect prefers-reduced-motion.
